name: Robin Falconer
story: Robin Falconer worked as an independent geospatial consultant after running GeoResearch Associates from 1980 to 1994. His work included marine bathymetry, environmental assessment and GIS.

In the early 1990s, GeoResearch Associates mapped bathymetry for the Deepwater Fisheries Group. In evidence to the Environmental Protection Authority in 2014, Falconer recalled buying what he described as New Zealand’s second PC ARC/INFO system and taking part in the formation of the Esri user group.

Falconer described GeoResearch Associates as a small practice with himself and one or two assistants. His later account offers a practitioner’s perspective on the early PC ARC/INFO market and New Zealand’s developing GIS community.
